Quayside Reels

Winter landings at the north quay

The harbor master walks the north quay and explains which landings the ferry will use over the winter, why the outer steps close when the swell runs from the east, and how the timetable changes on the days the quay is shut for the repairs that follow the October storms.

The video ends at the ticket office, where the winter fares for each crossing are posted, with the dates the timetable takes effect and the number to call when a crossing is cancelled for the weather.
